en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city taken from a wooden pavilion or balcony with carved railings in the foreground. A river runs through the city with quays and multiple bridges; dense blocks of 3–5‑story buildings with red roofs line both sides of the river. Church towers rise among the houses, and low mountains or hills appear in the distance. The scene is framed ornamentally by the pavilion structure. Faint printed text in German appears in the upper left sky area.
